status: Asset storyboard only; untimed; no recorded narration or film timeline

beats.headline: Context is control.
beats.copy: An outside Hermes does not automatically inherit this Herdr session's pane, socket or caller context.
beats.visual: A Hermes cubie approaches three empty slots labelled pane, socket and caller. The pieces have not connected yet.
beats.qualification: An external instance can be configured separately. Do not claim that every external Hermes is inherently incapable of Herdr access.

beats.headline: Choose. Trust. Bind.
beats.copy: Hermes on Herdr links the trusted Profile you choose directly to the current session.
beats.visual: A selected Profile cubie moves through the plugin boundary. The context pieces meet it and settle into a shared row.
beats.qualification: Use an existing dedicated trusted Profile. No automatic access grant to arbitrary Hermes instances; no implemented first-run setup wizard.
beats.requiredVisibleCaption: Dedicated trusted Profile, explicitly selected by you.

beats.headline: Control with an owner.
beats.copy: The dedicated Gateway runs in a real managed pane, with verified ownership and session control context.
beats.visual: A monitor texture faces the viewer while small pane, socket and caller cubies align behind it. A subtle connector stays inside the session boundary.
beats.qualification: Lifecycle management is implemented with persisted pause intent. Full real cold-start/shutdown and online handoff validation remain incomplete.
beats.requiredVisibleCaption: Pause intent persists. Full cold-start/exit verification remains incomplete.

beats.headline: Herdr manages the team.
beats.copy: Codex. Grok. Pi. Claude Code. Your coding agents, arranged by Herdr. Hermes is the M2 above that manager.
beats.visual: Four candy-colored coding-agent cubies rotate into a layer. Herdr aligns that layer; the Hermes cubie connects the person outside to the manager.
beats.qualification: Synthetic task/status panels illustrate roles. They are not recorded work or evidence of live task completion.

beats.headline: Your channels. Your M2.
beats.copy: Use Hermes's existing channels to reach that trusted manager while you are away.
beats.visual: A Discord cubie approaches Hermes along a solid illustrative route. Telegram and Slack wait beside it with UPSTREAM / UNVERIFIED labels. No channel directly controls a pane; no completed live request is claimed.
beats.qualification: Channels require credentials and authorized user policies. Discord connectivity is recorded; Telegram/Slack plugin integrations and complete fresh message-to-pane round trips are not yet independently verified.
beats.requiredVisibleCaption: Configure credentials and allowed users. Discord connected; Telegram/Slack integration unverified.

beats.headline: Send the work. Skip the remote login.
beats.copy: No SSH, remote desktop, VPN or exposed Herdr control port is required for this channel-based workflow.
beats.visual: The person and message remain outside a pale local-session outline. The control connector and Herdr panes stay inside it.
beats.qualification: The host, Herdr and Gateway must remain online and reach the selected messaging and model services. This does not promise offline operation or universal network reachability.
beats.requiredVisibleCaption: Host, Herdr and Gateway stay online, with messaging and model access.

beats.headline: Trusted. Bound. Local.
beats.copy: Full Herdr control in the bound session. Local permissions and ownership checks still apply.
beats.visual: The nearly complete cube holds inside the session outline. The Profile choice remains visible; nothing opens a public control surface.
beats.qualification: Session binding is not an OS sandbox or a per-pane ACL. The local terminal retains the user's UID permissions. Do not depict a hard isolation vault.
beats.requiredVisibleCaption: Not an OS sandbox. The local terminal retains your UID permissions.

beats.headline: Put the team in order. Take your weekend back.
beats.visual: All 27 cubies settle into one complete 3-by-3 cube. Hold the product name in generous light space.
beats.qualification: An aspirational payoff, not a guarantee of unattended correctness.
beats.requiredVisibleCaption: Human judgment still owns the outcome.

beats.headline: hexly.ai
beats.visual: Use the published shared logo reveal: official mark centered alone, then shift left as the full wordmark appears. Product caption follows.
beats.qualification: Reference only in this preparation. No shared template code was copied or executed; the favicon must not replace the actual end-slate mark.
